rawContent: Never have any doubt that a confident & decent man is never threatened by abused women/girls speaking up against abuse & misogyny. They will support campaigns like #MeToo because their masculinity is not threatened by confident females or predatory men.

(Excuse the language.) Yes, we live in a society where people are innocent until proven guilty but I don’t know how anyone is shocked by #SurvivingRKellly claims. He’s had sex scandal after sex scandal for 2 decades. He didn’t even pretend to be a loveable guy like Cosby. #MeToo

Also, does anyone know if #SurvigingRKelly will be airing in the UK? I read a really moving article about how these women came together to make this possible despite death threats & I think it’s time that his victims have the chance to be heard by anyone ready to listen. #metoo

The past few years have starting to stir society which is helping people to speak up/listen. Predators are also starting to sweat knowing they might be next to be exposed. Nevertheless, there are still lots of lessons to learn from the #metoo #SurvivingRKelley movements.

We need men to speak up more. When it comes to CSE & rape culture you are either an abuser, facilitator or challenger. If you suspect abuse & ignore it you are part of the problem. #SurvigingRKelly #CSE #metoo

No dream or utility bill is worth more than another person’s safety, wellbeing & trauma. A shiny suit & branded clothes aren’t worth swapping your integrity & conscience for. You are buying into BS & chasing superficial crap to facilitate abuse! #SurvivingRKelley #CSE #Metoo
